archetype: 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) - Adapted for Soft Utility Mobile Dashboard

design_philosophy.core: Mobile-first, high-density, utility-driven interface for Latino contractors in the field.
design_philosophy.typography: High contrast, structural grayscale hierarchy. Bold titles, subtle labels.
design_philosophy.spacing: Dense but clear. Generous padding in cards (p-5 or p-6) but tight gaps between elements (gap-3 or gap-4).
design_philosophy.buttons: Eliminated 'gigantic' buttons. Replaced with compact horizontal scrollers, floating action buttons, and list-style triggers.

media.description: Abstract pink/purple light gradient used for the Marketing Studio promo banner background (with mix-blend-overlay).

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPLEMENTATION LANGUAGE: All static UI text MUST be in Spanish (e.g., 'Buenos días', 'Pagos pendientes', 'Agregar cliente').

MOBILE FIRST: The entire layout must look perfect on a standard mobile width (375px-430px). Use horizontal scrolling (overflow-x-auto, snap-x) for the guided action flow to save vertical space and eliminate 'gigantic' buttons.
HERO KPI: Use the inverted contrast (slate-900 background) to make the 'Pagos pendientes' value pop. Include a 'Ver invoices' pill button inside it.
GUIDED ACTION FLOW: Build a horizontal list of 3 cards. Step 1: Agregar cliente (Blue chip), Step 2: Crear cotización con AI (Purple chip), Step 3: Crear invoice (Emerald chip).
STATS GRID: Render 4 boxes. Clientes (Blue), Quotes enviados (Purple), Invoices pendientes (Amber), Trabajos activos (Emerald). Use the w-11 h-11 rounded-full chips for the icons.
ONBOARDING: Implement a simple checklist card that shows progress (e.g., '2/4 completado').
LISTS: Use the list_section component for Recent Quotes and Upcoming Reminders. Keep the typography crisp and data clearly separated.
FAB: Implement the '+ Crear' button strictly as fixed at bottom-6 right-4. This is the primary escape hatch for actions.
ICONS: Use lucide-react. Standardize stroke-width to 2 or 2.5 for better legibility.
TESTING: Ensure every interactive element (buttons, scroll cards, list items) has a semantic 'data-testid' (e.g., data-testid='add-client-card').
